Input: a lift of 80 kg x 5 reps.
Epley = 80 x (1 + 5/30) = 93.3 kg; Brzycki = 80 x 36/(37 - 5) = 90 kg; Lombard...
map.举重/力量训练者由多次重复重量反推单次最大(1RM)，制定各百分比训练负荷。: Weightlifters and strength trainees back out a single-rep max (1RM) from several repetitions at a given load to set percentage-based training loads.
map.用多公式（Epley/Brzycki 等）交叉验证，减少单一公式偏差。: Cross-validate with several formulas (Epley/Brzycki and similar) to reduce single-formula bias.
map.周期性复测 1RM 跟踪力量进步，调整周期化计划。: Periodically retest the 1RM to track strength progress and adjust the periodized plan.
map.次数越多误差越大，超过 10 次不建议反推 1RM: The more repetitions, the larger the error; back out a 1RM from more than 10 reps is not recommended
map.由亚极限组推算既安全又足以指导配负荷（如 80% 1RM 做力量耐力），新手尤其: Back out from submaximal sets to find a load that is safe and sufficient for programming (for example 80% 1RM for strength endurance); beginners in particular should avoid frequent max testing
map.次数越少（≤5 次）估算越准，Epley/Brzycki 在 1–10 次区间常: Fewer reps (5 or fewer) give a more accurate estimate, and Epley/Brzycki are commonly used in the 1-10 rep range. The more reps the larger the error, so back out a 1RM from more than 10 reps is not recommended. Taking the median of several formulas is steadier than a single formula.
map.为什么不直接测真实 1RM？: Why not measure a true 1RM directly?
map.真实 1RM 测试风险高、需充分热身与保护，且神经疲劳大。由亚极限组推算既安全又: A true 1RM test is risky and needs thorough warm-up and spotters, and it causes heavy neural fatigue. Back out from submaximal sets to find a load that is safe and sufficient for programming (for example 80% 1RM for strength endurance); beginners in particular should avoid frequent max testing.
